definitionHe: אף על פי כן, ובכל זאת
definitionEn: in spite of what has just been said
exampleSentence: The evidence was thin; nevertheless, the theory persisted.

definitionHe: בעוד ש, לעומת זאת (ניגוד בין שתי עובדות)
definitionEn: in contrast to the fact that; while on the other hand
exampleSentence: The northern region relies on agriculture, whereas the southern region depends on tourism.

definitionEn: in spite of; without being opposed by
exampleSentence: Notwithstanding several objections, the committee approved the new policy.

definitionEn: used to introduce a statement that contrasts with what was just said
exampleSentence: The drug reduced symptoms in most patients; however, three participants withdrew due to side effects.

definitionHe: אף על פי כן, בכל זאת
definitionEn: in spite of that; nevertheless
exampleSentence: The sample size was small; nonetheless, the pattern was consistent across every trial.

definitionEn: introducing a fact or idea that is the reverse of one already mentioned
exampleSentence: Higher interest rates tend to cool spending; conversely, lower rates tend to encourage it.

definitionEn: although; even though
exampleSentence: The plan succeeded, albeit more slowly than the committee had hoped.

definitionHe: בעוד ש- (ניגוד או בו-זמניות; ניסוח בריטי ל-while)
definitionEn: while; at the same time as, or in contrast to
exampleSentence: Whilst the pilot program showed promise, the full rollout was delayed by budget cuts.

definitionEn: used to show how two things being compared are different
exampleSentence: In contrast, the control group received no additional instruction at all.

definitionEn: used to introduce a statement that emphatically contradicts the one before it
exampleSentence: The policy did not reduce costs; on the contrary, spending rose by twelve percent.

definitionEn: as a result; therefore
exampleSentence: The bridge was closed for repairs; consequently, traffic was rerouted through the old town.

definitionEn: for that reason; consequently
exampleSentence: No control group was used; therefore, the results cannot rule out a placebo effect.

definitionEn: as a result or consequence of this; in this manner
exampleSentence: Costs fell sharply once automation was introduced, thus improving overall margins.

definitionEn: for this reason; as a consequence
exampleSentence: The valley receives almost no rainfall, hence the sparse vegetation.

definitionEn: because of a particular action or set of circumstances
exampleSentence: The harbor silted up over decades; as a result, larger ships could no longer dock there.

definitionEn: caused by or resulting from a particular thing
exampleSentence: The flight was delayed due to a mechanical inspection.

definitionEn: because of; on account of
exampleSentence: Owing to a shortage of reviewers, the journal's response time nearly doubled.

definitionEn: in a way that suits the particular circumstances; consequently
exampleSentence: Demand for the course tripled, and the department accordingly added two more sections.

definitionEn: because of the reason just given
exampleSentence: The device failed the first safety test; for this reason, production was postponed.

definitionEn: because of
exampleSentence: The match was rescheduled on account of the storm warning.

definitionEn: in the intervening period of time; at the same time
exampleSentence: The lab began sequencing the samples; meanwhile, the field team continued collecting new specimens.

definitionEn: in the period of time between two events
exampleSentence: The final report will take months to prepare; in the meantime, a short summary was released.

definitionEn: after a particular event or time; afterward
exampleSentence: The drug was approved for adults and subsequently tested in adolescents as well.

definitionEn: after that time; from then on
exampleSentence: The treaty was signed in 1985, and relations improved steadily thereafter.

definitionEn: from this time on
exampleSentence: The board ruled that henceforth all expenses over a set limit would require prior approval.

definitionEn: before, in time or order
exampleSentence: Prior to the merger, the two companies competed for the same customers.

definitionEn: immediately when; the moment that
exampleSentence: Researchers published the findings as soon as the peer review process concluded.

definitionEn: at the same time as something else
exampleSentence: Two independent teams simultaneously published nearly identical findings.

definitionEn: after a long time; eventually, or in full detail
exampleSentence: The negotiators argued for hours and, at length, reached a compromise.

definitionEn: at the appropriate or expected time, without being hurried
exampleSentence: The committee promised a full response in due course, without setting an exact date.

definitionHe: יתר על כן, נוסף על כך
definitionEn: in addition; besides (introducing a further point)
exampleSentence: The proposal lacked a budget; furthermore, it gave no timeline for implementation.

definitionEn: used to introduce a further point that supports or adds to the previous one
exampleSentence: The material is cheaper to produce; moreover, it degrades far more slowly.

definitionEn: as an added factor or circumstance; in addition
exampleSentence: Additionally, the survey excluded anyone under eighteen years old.

definitionEn: as well; besides what has already been mentioned
exampleSentence: In addition, participants received a small stipend for their time.

definitionEn: in addition to; apart from
exampleSentence: Besides lowering costs, the new process also reduced waste by a third.

definitionEn: in the same way; similarly
exampleSentence: The first cohort showed improved recall; the second cohort, likewise, performed better than expected.

definitionEn: in a way that resembles something already mentioned
exampleSentence: The first experiment used untreated soil; similarly, the second relied on no fertilizer at all.

definitionEn: in addition to; and also
exampleSentence: The grant covers travel costs as well as conference registration fees.

definitionEn: together with; in addition to
exampleSentence: The final report, along with all supporting data, was submitted before the deadline.

definitionEn: used to introduce a further, often more significant, point
exampleSentence: The new route cuts travel time in half; what is more, it costs less to maintain.
